_comment: Questions for the answer-faithfulness eval, one list per dataset in evals/data/. Deliberately question-only: faithfulness asks whether an answer is grounded in its retrieved context, not whether it is correct, so no reference answers are needed and none are collected. Every question is answerable from its document, so a low score means the generator drifted, not that the document was silent.
sample.txt: What problem does retrieval-augmented generation solve?
